# Enjoys an array of `[ukulele, gardening, programming, photography, kaiju, coffee, cats]`.

Jordan Carmona is a mythical cryptid living in the Pacific Northwest. He wishes he had a tidy job title.
On any given day he does data engineering, devops & infrastructure as code, database administration & tuning,
distributed computing and (big) data analytics, programming, and sometimes cartography.

He began working professionally in 2014 and has worked in a variety of sectors:
private consulting, municipal government, and retail. Jordan is a self-taught developer,
Part 107 sUAS remote pilot, and certified GISP. He has experience in the entire vertical of geospatial systems,
from data digitization and GNSS field collection to analytics, automations, administration, and managing a geospatial department.

His professional involvement with the industry includes a term on the Geospatial Professional Network (GPN) Vanguard Cabinet,
board member and officer for GPN Texas, and perennial lurker on the GIS Discord group. Jordan has a dual BA in
History and Political Science from the University of North Texas.
His alignment is Chaotic Good.
